name: Domain Verifier
description: Prove domain ownership through a DNS TXT / CNAME record or a file hosted on the site.

hints.httpFile: The site file is fetched from `https://<domain>/<path>` and must return 200 with an exact match.
hints.resolvers: Leave empty to use the system resolvers; each resolver is compared separately.

faq.a: Yes. Each resolver reports its own outcome and any match makes the overall result a match.

faq.q: Why must the site file match exactly?
faq.a: Exact matching avoids false positives; leading and trailing whitespace is ignored.

faq.q: Can I verify an internal domain?
faq.a: DNS methods can; `http-file` needs egress, so private addresses are blocked.
